title: Easeworks — Motion Timeline Studio
description: Keyframe a scene on a six-lane timeline, shape every easing curve by hand, then export real CSS @keyframes.
concept: Easeworks is a small motion-design workstation. You scrub a timeline, drop keyframes on six property lanes (X, Y, scale, rotate, opacity, blur), and drag the two control handles of each key's cubic-bezier to build overshoot, anticipation or stepped motion. Any object can be multiplied into a staggered group of up to 24 copies with per-copy delay and spread, so a single track becomes a choreographed wave. When it looks right, the scene leaves as production CSS — @keyframes with per-keyframe timing functions and nth-child stagger delays — plus a JSON project, a PNG contact-sheet filmstrip and a shareable URL.
features: Six-lane keyframe timeline: click a lane to key, drag diamonds to retime, drag the ruler to scrub
Cubic-bezier editor with draggable handles, overshoot past the box, plus 12 presets including steps() and hold
Stagger engine: 1–24 copies per object with delay, spread X/Y, rendered live
Four starter scenes (Dot Wave, Card Reveal, Menu Stagger, Pulse Grid) and five primitive shapes
Export CSS @keyframes with per-keyframe timing functions and nth-child stagger delays
Export PNG filmstrip contact sheet, JSON project file, and a base64 share link
localStorage autosave restores the scene you were editing

interaction.mouse: Drag keyframe diamonds along a lane to retime; drag the ruler to scrub the playhead; drag the two bezier handles to shape the curve
interaction.click: Click an empty lane to drop a keyframe at that time; click object chips to switch objects; click easing presets to swap curves
interaction.touch: Every timeline and curve gesture is pointer-based, so taps and drags work the same on a phone; the panel scrolls under the stage
interaction.keyboard: Space play/pause · ← → step one frame · K key the selected property at the playhead · Delete removes the selected key
